profile.headline: Software Engineer II at SpaceX
profile.summary: I was a founding engineer of an EHR software startup that raised $3M in a seed round. I studied intelligent systems, applied mathematics, entrepreneurship and physics at Columbia University.

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Built the frontend component library that has been imported 1800 times. Developed a design system on Storybook and automated end-to-end testing using Playwright.
• Developed the backend for prescriber ordering and infusion charting. Designed healthcare data models compliant with FHIR standards and implemented typesafe APIs with ACID properties.
• Accelerated the digitalization of purchase order invoices using Google Document AI and GPT-4o.
• Built messaging and notification services by integrating with self-hosted Mattermost and Novu to enable in-app communication between hundreds of users.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Improved healthcare providers' efficiency by automating the reordering and verification of one million titration drugs in response to changes in titration parameters.
• Owned the project from research, to design, to development, to testing. Conducted onsite interviews with healthcare providers. Designed and developed new features using C# and TypeScript.
• Coordinated the internationalization and localization of a clinical software.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Prototyped Korea’s leading data security company’s new product in Java.
• Built the prototype’s server on top of the Netty framework and connected it to the PostgreSQL database using JDBC. Enabled socket communication between the prototype and other applications.

volunteerExperiences.description: • Facilitated weekly congregation, hosted guest speakers, co-organized events for student welfare and homeless outreach.

projects.title: Culpa
projects.description:
• Designed and developed a new version of Columbia University’s professor and course review site with 10,000 monthly users.
• Implemented a new search engine that uses full text search to autocomplete the user input. Reduced the maximum duration of search from 1 second to 300 milliseconds.
